title: Delivery & Pickup Appointments Fee Ledger: Payment, Waiver and Refund of Billed Fees
content:
Three kinds of fee can be billed on a Delivery & Pickup Appointment: the delivery fee, the reschedule fee and the missed-appointment fee. The appointment's fees due are the fees billed on it that have not yet been paid, waived or refunded. A settlement is recorded against the fee entry it settles.

## Settlement rules

**S1. Settlement types.** Each billed fee is settled once, as one of three types, and each fee entry is settled once:
- **paid**, when the customer pays it;
- **waived**, when one of the waivers in these Delivery & Pickup Appointments rules applies;
- **refunded**, when a paid fee becomes refundable.

Whether a fee entry has already been settled is read from the appointment's fee ledger, by the fee entry the settlement refers to.

**S2. Grounds for a waiver.** The waivers in these rules are:
- a Kestrel-caused miss;
- a weather-forced reschedule billed in error;
- an exchange delivery fee that the fulfillment method waives.

A fee is never waived on request without one of these grounds.

**S3. Refund of a paid delivery fee.** A paid delivery fee is refunded:
- when the purchase order is cancelled before handover and the method's cancellation switch is on; or
- when the vehicle is returned under the 7-day return and the method's return switch is on.

**S4. Fees that are never refunded.** Reschedule fees and missed-appointment fees that have been paid are never refunded.

**S5. Refund timing.** Refunds go to the original card within the method's fee refund business days.

## Settlement matrix

| Fee type | Paid by the customer | Waived (S2) | Refunded after payment (S3 and S4) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Delivery fee | Yes | When the method waives the exchange delivery fee | Order cancelled before handover with the cancellation switch on, or a 7-day return with the return switch on |
| Reschedule fee | Yes | A weather-forced reschedule billed in error, or, while still unpaid, after a Kestrel-caused miss under a method whose waiver switch is on | Never |
| Missed-appointment fee | Yes | While still unpaid, after a Kestrel-caused miss under a method whose waiver switch is on | Never |

## Ledger questions

**A customer asks for a reschedule fee to be waived as a courtesy, and none of the three grounds applies.** The fee is not waived. A fee is never waived on request without one of the grounds.

**A missed-appointment fee was paid, and the order is later cancelled before handover.** The fee stays paid. Paid missed-appointment fees are never refunded.

**Hypothetical ledger.** An appointment carries a delivery fee of $210.00, which has been paid, and a reschedule fee of $60.00, which has not. Its fees due are $60.00: only the unpaid reschedule fee is still open.
